question: Which country has become the first to develop genome-edited rice varieties?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India becomes 1st country in world to develop genome-edited rice varieties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India is the first country** in the world to develop **genome-edited rice varieties**.

 
 
• 
 
The varieties were launched by **Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan**.

 
 
• 
 
Developed by **ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research)** institutions.

 
 
• 
 
Two varieties launched:

 
 
• 
 
**DRR Dhan 100 Kamala** – derived from Samba Mahsuri, **matures 15–20 days earlier**, yields **25% more**.

 
 
• 
 
**Pusa DST Rice 1** – **tolerant to salinity and alkalinity**, yields **30% more** in saline conditions.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Recommended for states: **AP, Bihar, UP, Telangana, Karnataka, TN, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, WB, and MP**.

 
 
• 
 
**5 million hectares** of cultivation expected to yield **4.5 million tons of additional paddy**.
